title: Abelian coefficient clause of hypercover cohomology
statement: The abelian-group clause of thm-weil-pbc-hypercover-cohomology: for every qcqs scheme X and q, FiniteSplitEtaleHypercover.IsCohomologyColimit AddCommGrpCat q (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat) 0 ⋙ Etale.cohomology AddCommGrpCat X q).

proof.text: Apply the existing source-library theorem `AlgebraicGeometry.hypercover_cohomology`, whose conjunction contains the abelian coefficient clause as its first component, and project that component.

lean.statement: theorem hypercover_cohomology_abelian_part (X : Scheme.{u₁}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (q : ℕ) : FiniteSplitEtaleHypercover.IsCohomologyColimit AddCommGrpCat.{u₁ + 1} q (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u₁ + 1}) 0 ⋙ Etale.cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u₁ + 1} X (q : ℤ))
